verses.text: 'For behold, in those days and at that time, When I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.textZh: 到那日，我使猶大和耶路撒冷被擄之人歸回的時候，

verses.text: I will gather all the nations And bring them down to the valley of Jehoshaphat. Then I will enter into judgment with them there On behalf of My people and My inheritance, Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations; And they have divided up My land.
verses.textZh: 我要聚集萬民，帶他們下到約沙法谷，在那裡施行審判；因為他們將我的百姓，就是我的產業以色列，分散在列國中，又分取我的地土，

verses.text: 'They have also cast lots for My people, Traded a boy for a harlot And sold a girl for wine that they may drink.
verses.textZh: 且為我的百姓拈鬮，將童子換妓女，賣童女買酒喝。

verses.text: 'Moreover, what are you to Me, O Tyre, Sidon and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering Me a recompense? But if you do recompense Me, swiftly and speedily I will return your recompense on your head.
verses.textZh: 推羅、西頓，和非利士四境的人哪，你們與我何干？你們要報復我麼？若報復我，我必使報應速速歸到你們的頭上。

verses.text: 'Since you have taken My silver and My gold, brought My precious treasures to your temples,
verses.textZh: 你們既然奪取我的金銀，又將我可愛的寶物帶入你們宮殿（或譯：廟中），

verses.text: and sold the sons of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks in order to remove them far from their territory,
verses.textZh: 並將猶大人和耶路撒冷人賣給希利尼人（原文是雅完人），使他們遠離自己的境界。

verses.text: behold, I am going to arouse them from the place where you have sold them, and return your recompense on your head.
verses.textZh: 我必激動他們離開你們所賣到之地，又必使報應歸到你們的頭上。

verses.text: 'Also I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the sons of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, to a distant nation,' for the LORD has spoken.
verses.textZh: 我必將你們的兒女賣在猶大人的手中，他們必賣給遠方示巴國的人。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare a war; rouse the mighty men! Let all the soldiers draw near, let them come up!
verses.textZh: 當在萬民中宣告說：要預備打仗；激動勇士，使一切戰士上前來。

verses.text: Beat your plowshares into swords And your pruning hooks into spears; Let the weak say, 'I am a mighty man.'
verses.textZh: 要將犁頭打成刀劍，將鐮刀打成戈矛；軟弱的要說：我有勇力。

verses.text: Hasten and come, all you surrounding nations, And gather yourselves there. Bring down, O LORD, Your mighty ones.
verses.textZh: 四圍的列國啊，你們要速速地來，一同聚集。耶和華啊，求你使你的大能者降臨。

verses.text: Let the nations be aroused And come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat, For there I will sit to judge All the surrounding nations.
verses.textZh: 萬民都當興起，上到約沙法谷；因為我必坐在那裡，審判四圍的列國。

verses.text: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full; The vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.
verses.textZh: 開鐮罷！因為莊稼熟了；踐踏罷！因為酒醡滿了。酒池盈溢；他們的罪惡甚大。

verses.text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
verses.textZh: 許多許多的人在斷定谷，因為耶和華的日子臨近斷定谷。

verses.text: The sun and moon grow dark And the stars lose their brightness.
verses.textZh: 日月昏暗，星宿無光。

verses.text: The LORD roars from Zion And utters His voice from Jerusalem, And the heavens and the earth tremble. But the LORD is a refuge for His people And a stronghold to the sons of Israel.
verses.textZh: 耶和華必從錫安吼叫，從耶路撒冷發聲，天地就震動。耶和華卻要作他百姓的避難所，作以色列人的保障。

verses.text: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, Dwelling in Zion, My holy mountain. So Jerusalem will be holy, And strangers will pass through it no more.
verses.textZh: 你們就知道我是耶和華─你們的神，且又住在錫安─我的聖山。那時，耶路撒冷必成為聖；外邦人不再從其中經過。

verses.text: And in that day The mountains will drip with sweet wine, And the hills will flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah will flow with water; And a spring will go out from the house of the LORD To water the valley of Shittim.
verses.textZh: 到那日，大山要滴甜酒；小山要流奶子；猶大溪河都有水流。必有泉源從耶和華的殿中流出來，滋潤什亭谷。

verses.text: Egypt will become a waste, And Edom will become a desolate wilderness, Because of the violence done to the sons of Judah, In whose land they have shed innocent blood.
verses.textZh: 埃及必然荒涼，以東變為悽涼的曠野，都因向猶大人所行的強暴，又因在本地流無辜人的血。

verses.text: But Judah will be inhabited forever And Jerusalem for all generations.
verses.textZh: 但猶大必存到永遠；耶路撒冷必存到萬代。

verses.text: And I will avenge their blood which I have not avenged, For the LORD dwells in Zion.
verses.textZh: 我未曾報復（或譯：洗除；下同）流血的罪，現在我要報復，因為耶和華住在錫安。
